notes.subject: i pasin olgeta
notes.rationale: יתהוללו come from הלל — em i min olsem 'ol i krai tumas / ol i pasin'; narapela ridim: 'ol i sangumaut'.

notes.subject: ישתקשקון
notes.rationale: Dabel tok שׁקק insait long wanpela tok — reduplication bilong toktok i wok long tanim.

notes.subject: lukluk bilong olgeta
notes.rationale: Stia bilong lukluk: olsem paia-lamp, olsem braunlai — tupela klosup piksa.

translation: Long ol stret, ol kariot i pasin olgeta; ol i go na i kam long ol braod ples. Lukluk bilong olgeta i olsem ol paia-lamp; olsem braunlai ol i ran.

tokens.gloss: ol i go na i kam
